type Merge<A, B, C> = A & B & C;
const direct: any & string & number = 42;
const generic: Merge<any, string, number> = 42;
const distinctUnits: Merge<1, any, 2> = 42;
const booleanDomain: Merge<string, boolean, any> = 42;
const objectDomain: Merge<boolean, any, object> = 42;
const nullish: Merge<any, null, undefined> = 42;
const disjointTemplateDomain: Merge<`id-${string}`, any, number> = 42;
const disjointTemplateValue: Merge<any, `id-${number}`, 'id-bad'> = 42;
const disjointMappedValue: Merge<Uppercase<string>, any, 'lower'> = 42;
